JPS-9030 Photoelectron Spectroscopy Device (XPS) 
Something that everyone can easily use right away. 
Japan Electronics Co., Ltd. JPS-9030 Photoelectron Spectroscopy System (XPS) adopts a newly designed user interface that can be operated in a Japanese environment, achieving "anyone can easily and immediately use it." In addition, it comes standard with a Kaufman-type etching ion source and twin anodes, and while being a general-purpose XPS, it also has a wide range of expandability, including a high-temperature heating system and gas cluster ion source.
〇 Features
- Depth profiling (depth direction analysis) that accommodates a wide range of purposes from nm to μm
- Newly developed software focused on ease of use
- Ultra-high sensitivity comparable to high-end models
- Abundant options
*For more details, please download the PDF or feel free to contact us.
